title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8 Review: The Littlest Smartphone That Could

claims.claim: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip8, bir önceki modele göre 100 dolar daha pahalıdır.

evidence.quote: Like almost every other phone this year, the Z Flip8 offers tiny improvements over its predecessor and costs $100 more.

claims.claim: Z Flip8, selefine kıyasla 0.02 inç daha ince ve 8 gram daha hafiftir.

evidence.quote: The Z Flip8 shaves off 0.02 inches (0.55 millimeters) and a third of an ounce (8 grams) compared to its predecessor, making it the slimmest and lightest option in this category.

claims.claim: Cihaz, suya karşı dayanıklılık sağlayan IP48 derecesine sahiptir.

evidence.quote: The Flip8 has an IP48 rating, so you don’t need to worry about dropping it in the bath
The Flip8 has an IP48 rating, so you don’t need to worry about dropping it in the bath, but tiny dust and dirt particles (less than 1 millimeter) can still cause damage.

claims.claim: Z Flip8, dış yüzde 4.1 inç ve iç yüzde 6.9 inç AMOLED ekran ile gelmektedir.

evidence.quote: It has a sharp 4.1-inch AMOLED display on the outside with a 60- or 120-Hz refresh rate. Open it up to reveal the 6.9-inch main display, also AMOLED

It has a sharp 4.1-inch AMOLED display on the outside with a 60- or 120-Hz refresh rate. Open it up to reveal the 6.9-inch main display, also AMOLED but with a variable refresh rate (1 to 120 Hz) that’s better for battery life.

claims.claim: Telefon, Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy işlemciye, 12 GB RAM'e ve 256 GB depolama alanına sahiptir.

evidence.quote: the Z Flip8 boasts the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy (the same cutting-edge chip that's in its two bigger siblings). It has 12 GB of RAM and 256 GB of storage.

claims.claim: Cihazın depolama alanını 512 GB'a yükseltmek 200 dolara mal olmaktadır.

evidence.quote: You can jump to 512 GB for an extra $200, but there’s no option to increase the RAM.

claims.claim: Z Flip8, 4.300 mAh kapasiteli silikon-karbon pil ile beslenmektedir.

evidence.quote: Samsung put in a 4,300-mAh silicon-carbon battery that’s good enough for casual use.

claims.claim: Telefon 25 watt kablolu ve 15 watt kablosuz şarj hızlarını desteklemektedir.

evidence.quote: Charging speeds are disappointing at 25 watts wired and 15 watts wireless
Charging speeds are disappointing at 25 watts wired and 15 watts wireless, and I’m annoyed by Samsung’s refusal to implement the magnetic feature of Qi2.
